name: Health screening & diagnostic labs (category guide)
summary: Full-body packages vs GP/polyclinic bloodwork — what corporate riders actually reimburse, EP medical vs elective screening, and when a fancy MRI package is theatre.
body: Expats on Reddit split into two camps: cheap annual blood panels at polyclinics / panel GPs, versus private ‘executive’ packages (Raffles, Parkway, ATA-style centres, SATA) that finish in a morning and email PDF results. Foreigners pay unsubsidised rates either way — the package premium buys speed and bundling, not MOH co-funding. Read your group outpatient rider before buying: many plans reimburse diagnostic tests only when ordered by a panel doctor for a complaint, not cash health-screening SKUs, and some carve imaging out entirely. EP issuance / renewal medicals are a separate MOM checklist — do not assume a wellness package substitutes for the designated clinic form. Prefer annual affordable panels you will actually repeat over a once-off S$2k MRI buffet that never gets trended. Ask who interprets abnormal results and whether a GP consult is included; orphaned lab PDFs are a common complaint. This is a category guide for shopping screening honestly, not a ranked lab list.
